name: CM44_everything_traces_to_truth
origins: user requirement 2026-10-22 (source of truth, action, transformation and method as the goal)
statement: Every artifact traces back to the four sources. An action names its truth (a definition) and the method that made it, and links to it by a proof, a witness or as its source, never refuted; a transformation names the two truths it relates and its evidence; a definition names its origin and carries its Gödel content over the ledger's atoms; a method states what it decides and its limits. Code is an action of a definition, and optimizing is the cheapest proven chain from truth through transformations to an action.
